title.en: Sui & Tang: A Prosperous, Open Age
title.zh: 隋唐：繁荣与开放的时代

clips.send: Deck and stone railings. The road across, with carved railings. The bridge is about 50 metres long and about 9 metres wide. Its stone railings are carved with dragons and other beasts — the bridge is a work of art as well as engineering. After about 1,400 years of floods and earthquakes it still stands.

clips.send: Emperor Wen of Sui began choosing officials by examinations in separate subjects; Emperor Yang created the jinshi exam, choosing talent by results — the formal birth of the imperial examination. Emperor Taizong, Wu Zetian and Emperor Xuanzong of Tang improved it further.

clips.send: In 641 Princess Wencheng married Songtsen Gampo, ruler of Tubo, bringing Central Plains techniques and books with her and strengthening Han–Tibetan friendship. This was a link between peoples within China.

clips.send: Chang’an became an international metropolis and Tang poetry reached its peak: Li Bai is called the “Poet Immortal” and Du Fu the “Poet Sage”. The An–Shi Rebellion of 755 turned the Tang from prosperity to decline; the dynasty ended in 907.

clips.send: 28 parallel arch rings. How the main arch is built. Look under the arch: the main arch is made of 28 separate arch rings laid side by side. If one ring is damaged it can be repaired on its own, without rebuilding the whole bridge.

clips.send: Under Emperor Taizong the monk Xuanzang set out west from Chang’an and, after great hardship, reached Tianzhu (India), where he studied at Nalanda Monastery. Back in Chang’an he dictated the Great Tang Records on the Western Regions.

clips.send: Japan sent envoys to the Tang more than ten times to learn. The Tang monk Jianzhen accepted an invitation to Japan; his first five attempts failed, and on the sixth — by then blind — he arrived and spread Buddhism, medicine, architecture and other Tang culture.

clips.send: From north to south the canal has four sections: the Yongji Canal, the Tongji Canal, the Hangou Canal and the Jiangnan Canal.
clips.text: From north to south the canal has four sections: the Yongji Canal, the Tongji Canal, the Hangou Canal and the Jiangnan Canal.

clips.send: Main arch. One great, flat stone arch over the river. The Zhaozhou Bridge (Anji Bridge) in today’s Zhao County, Hebei, was designed and built under the direction of the Sui craftsman Li Chun. Its single main arch spans more than 37 metres. The arch is a low, flat segment of a circle, so the deck slopes gently and carts can cross easily. It is the oldest surviving open-spandrel stone arch bridge in the world.

clips.send: Sui tyranny led to uprisings and the Sui fell in 618. That year Li Yuan founded the Tang with its capital at Chang’an. Emperor Taizong’s reign brought the “Reign of Zhenguan”; the early reign of Emperor Xuanzong brought the “Heyday of Kaiyuan”, the height of the Tang.

clips.send: The four sections link five great river systems: the Hai, Yellow, Huai, Yangtze and Qiantang. The Grand Canal was the longest canal of the ancient world; it improved north–south transport, promoted economic and cultural exchange, and strengthened national unity.

clips.send: In 581 Yang Jian founded the Sui with its capital at Chang’an; he is Emperor Wen of Sui. In 589 Sui armies conquered the Chen in the south, ending a long period of division and reuniting north and south.

clips.send: Small arches (open spandrels). Two small arches on each shoulder of the main arch. Instead of filling the shoulders of the main arch with solid stone, Li Chun opened four small arches. They make the bridge lighter and save stone. In a flood, water can also pass through the small arches, reducing the push of the flood on the bridge.

clips.send: To improve north–south transport and strengthen control of the whole country, Emperor Yang of Sui began the Grand Canal in 605. Centred on Luoyang, it reached Zhuojun in the north and Yuhang in the south — over 2,000 km long.

clips.send: 长安成为当时国际性的大都会，唐诗也达到顶峰，李白被誉为“诗仙”，杜甫被誉为“诗圣”。755年爆发安史之乱，唐朝由盛转衰；907年唐朝灭亡。

clips.send: 隋文帝开始用分科考试的方式选拔官员；隋炀帝时设置进士科，按考试成绩选拔人才，科举制正式诞生。唐太宗、武则天、唐玄宗时期，科举制不断完善。

clips.send: 隋朝暴政引发农民起义，618年隋朝灭亡。同年李渊建立唐朝，定都长安。唐太宗统治时期出现“贞观之治”；唐玄宗统治前期出现“开元盛世”，唐朝达到全盛。

clips.send: 为了加强南北交通、巩固对全国的统治，隋炀帝从605年起开通了一条纵贯南北的大运河。它以洛阳为中心，北抵涿郡，南至余杭，全长两千多千米。

clips.send: 小拱（敞肩拱）。大拱两肩各有两个小拱。李春没有把大拱两肩用石料填实，而是开了四个小拱。。这样可以减轻桥身的重量，节省石料。。发洪水时，水还能从小拱流过，减少洪水对桥身的冲击。

clips.send: 大运河由北向南分为四段：永济渠、通济渠、邗沟和江南河。

clips.send: 四段运河把海河、黄河、淮河、长江、钱塘江五大水系连接起来。大运河是古代世界上最长的运河，加强了南北交通，促进了南北经济、文化交流，巩固了国家统一。

clips.send: 大拱（主拱）。一个巨大而扁平的单孔石拱。赵州桥（安济桥）位于今河北赵县，由隋朝匠师李春主持设计建造。。主拱只有一个，跨度三十七米多；拱形扁平，桥面坡度平缓，便于车马通行。。它是世界上现存最古老的敞肩石拱桥。

clips.send: 日本先后十几次派遣唐使来唐朝学习。唐朝高僧鉴真应邀东渡，前五次都失败了，第六次才在双目失明的情况下到达日本，传播了佛学、医药、建筑等唐朝文化。
